en: Improved `OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES=file:<dir>` output: a new `index.jsonl` and `request_body_id` / `message.id` event attributes link each response to its request file and transcript message
zh: 改进了 `OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES=file:<dir>` 输出：新增的 `index.jsonl` 以及 `request_body_id` / `message.id` 事件属性可将每个响应关联到其请求文件和对话记录消息
